<?php
require_once 'wordpress/wp-load.php';

// A policy that has something to do the moment the screen opens.
update_option(
	'rvrt_settings',
	array(
		'keep'                     => 5,
		'max_age_days'             => 365,
		'post_types'               => array( 'page' => array( 'max_age_days' => 90 ) ),
		'enable_revisions'         => array(),
		'cron_enabled'             => true,
		'cron_interval'            => 'weekly',
		'batch_size'               => 200,
		'remove_data_on_uninstall' => false,
	)
);

// A history worth looking at: forty revisions of the sample post spread over
// roughly three years, so the keep floor and the age threshold both bite.
foreach ( array( 1 => 40, 2 => 12 ) as $parent => $total ) {
	if ( ! get_post( $parent ) ) {
		continue;
	}

	for ( $i = 1; $i <= $total; $i++ ) {
		$days = ( $total - $i ) * 30;
		$date = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( $days * DAY_IN_SECONDS ) );

		wp_insert_post(
			array(
				'post_type'         => 'revision',
				'post_status'       => 'inherit',
				'post_parent'       => $parent,
				'post_name'         => $parent . '-revision-v' . $i,
				'post_title'        => get_the_title( $parent ),
				'post_content'      => 'Revision ' . $i . ', saved ' . $days . ' days ago.',
				'post_date'         => $date,
				'post_date_gmt'     => $date,
				'post_modified'     => $date,
				'post_modified_gmt' => $date,
			)
		);
	}
}
